name: pool/two-at-once
description: GET /two — runs two half-second queries at the same time. With room for two connections they overlap and take about half a second; with a pool of one the second waits for the first.

data.js:
await Promise.all([dbQuery("SELECT pg_sleep(0.5)"), dbQuery("SELECT pg_sleep(0.5)")]);
return { done: 2 };
